authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. The MHCLG Local plan boundary dataset describes the areas covered by local plans and reports 364 boundaries; individual entities expose exact local-plan-boundary references and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. A bounded window of at most 50 candidates was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA, local-plan-boundary reference/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector that binds any candidate boundary to this slot. Selecting a boundary would therefore invent partition ownership. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
